decisions.reason: GA4 is the only Google Analytics standard, so the plugin serves ongoing shop-client demand and is cheap to maintain.
Universal Analytics has been fully shut down, so the option's value has resolved to zero and the maintenance effort is better spent on GA4 and core work.
The retail system interface plugin is a low-cost option that fits the firm's integration expertise, and its prospects are still uncertain enough to keep it open.
Relaunch SEO support complements the core relaunch business at little cost and remains prominently presented on its own page.
The SEO workshops are a recent, low-cost option that builds on existing expertise, and their value is still uncertain, so abandoning them would be premature.
